comment: invent.c getobj() with a count typed in the '?' inventory menu: wintty.c process_menu_window() keeps the count as a long (AppendLongDigit), so 9007199254741022, above 2^53, reaches getobj() and its quantity test prints "You don't have that many!  You have only 21." for the rocks. The port's single-choice menu dropped any count above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and dropped all 21 rocks. Seed, date, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
